assets.prompt:
Create a polished technical diagram for an educational robotics article, wide 3:2 landscape, white background, thin rounded borders, restrained pastel blue for perception, purple for motion transfer, orange for physics training, green for datasets and evaluation. Large legible sans-serif English labels, generous whitespace, no logos, no decorative title. The diagram explains NVIDIA Video to Data.
Top row: four rounded panels connected left-to-right with clear dark arrows:
1. "Human video" with a simple camera view of human hands lifting a tissue box.
2. "Reconstruction" with separate tiny icons of camera axes, a mesh tissue box, and hand skeletons. Sub-label "Scene + human motion".
3. "Retargeting" with a robot hand and torso alongside human hand. Sub-label "Robot reference motion".
4. "Physics + RL" with a robot hand physically holding the box on a table. Sub-label "Source expert".
From panel 4 an arrow curves downward into bottom row on the RIGHT, then the bottom workflow flows RIGHT TO LEFT with arrowheads facing left.
Bottom right panel labeled "Expert rollouts", sub-label "Images + states + actions", with small frame and table icons.
Bottom center panel labeled "GR00T fine-tuning", sub-label "Robot policy", with a compact neural-network icon.
Bottom left panel labeled "Closed-loop evaluation", sub-label "Observe > Act > Observe", with robot plus camera and a circular feedback arrow INSIDE THIS PANEL.
Exactly three bottom panels. Arrows: Physics + RL to Expert rollouts, Expert rollouts to GR00T fine-tuning, GR00T fine-tuning to Closed-loop evaluation. The arrow direction must be unmistakable. NO arrow directly from Human video to Robot policy. NO connection from Closed-loop evaluation back to Human video.
A slim detached strip above the top row reads "Optional clip selection: Video Ingestion Agent", containing a tiny video-strip icon and magnifier; a dotted arrow points down ONLY to Human video. This is an optional retrieval path, not a mandatory E2E stage.
All labels spelled exactly as given. No numbers, benchmarks, formulas, additional stages or text. Flat technical illustration with clear meaning even without colors.
assets.review: All seven stages and arrow directions inspected. Optional ingestion is shown separately; main E2E demonstration does not require retrieval. Robot silhouettes illustrate roles rather than exact embodiment geometry.

assets.prompt:
Draw a precise educational robotics block diagram, wide landscape 3:2, plain white background, thin rounded outlines, generous spacing, large sans-serif English labels. Pastel purple for reference, blue for observations, orange for actions and physics, green for training reward. No logo, no title, no equations or numerical results.
At top left place a purple box "Robot reference motion" with a simple three-pose ghost robot hand sequence manipulating a rigid box. A small sublabel says "Pose targets over time".
Below and toward center-left place a blue box "Current state". To its right at center place a purple box "Policy". To its right place an orange box "Action". To the right place a larger orange box "Physics simulation" showing a robot hand, rigid box and table.
Connect Current state -> Policy -> Action -> Physics simulation using bold solid dark arrows. An arrow exits BOTTOM of Physics simulation and goes in a spacious loop along the BOTTOM margin back into the BOTTOM of Current state. Label that return line "Next state". Arrow direction must be unmistakable.
A solid purple arrow from Robot reference motion enters TOP of Policy, representing reference-conditioned tracking.
In the upper middle-right place a green box "Tracking + contact reward".
A separate purple arrow branches from Robot reference motion across the top into the LEFT of Tracking + contact reward.
A solid blue arrow exits the TOP of Physics simulation and enters the RIGHT of Tracking + contact reward, labeled "Simulated motion + contacts".
A dashed green arrow exits BOTTOM of Tracking + contact reward and enters TOP of Policy, labeled "Training update".
A small compact legend below everything reads "Solid: rollout signals    Dashed: parameter update".
No reward arrow into Action or Physics. No direct Reference -> Action arrow. No direct pose assignment of the simulated object. The box and table icons are purely explanatory and not a particular robot model. Use clean routed edges so no arrow overlaps text. All exact labels must be readable and spelled correctly.
assets.review: Reference conditions actor and reward; simulator next state feeds actor; dashed update denotes training only. Critic, optimizer, curricula and observation details omitted. No measured contact-force claims.
